title: TemporalLightModulationAndPhotometricMetrologySchemaV3
description: Comprehensive photometric metrology specification defining explicit point-by-point spatial illuminance structures and rigorous optoelectronic signal processing parameters for high-frequency temporal light modulation.

path_1_spatial_illuminance_metrology.metric_description: Steady-state photopic illuminance E_v measured across 5 standardized corridor stations.

authoritative_spatial_acceptance_rule.definition: To prevent spatial averaging from concealing severe localized dark pockets or excessive glare hotspots, acceptance requires BOTH: (1) spatial_mean_lux in [300.0, 400.0] lux AND (2) EVERY_REQUIRED_MEASUREMENT_POINT satisfies 300.0 <= E_v <= 400.0 lux.
authoritative_spatial_acceptance_rule.rejection_condition: If any individual point < 300.0 lux or > 400.0 lux, Path 1 FAILS, even if the spatial average is exactly 350.0 lux.

instrument_metrology.instrument_type: Class B DIN 5032-7 Cosine-Corrected Lux Meter (Testo 540 / Gossen Mavolux 5032B)
instrument_metrology.photometric_response: CIE photopic spectral luminous efficiency V(lambda) match f1' <= 6.0%
instrument_metrology.calibration_reference: ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory photometer calibration certificate

path_2_flicker_and_modulation_metrology.metric_description: High-frequency temporal light modulation, Flicker Index (FI), and fundamental modulation frequency (f_mod).
path_2_flicker_and_modulation_metrology.standard_mandate_clarification: IEEE 1789-2015 provides risk-mitigation curves based on modulation frequency and percent flicker; it DOES NOT mandate the project's exact combination of FI <= 0.05 and f_mod >= 1000 Hz. This pair is designated PROJECT_CURRENT_ACCEPTANCE_TARGET.

optoelectronic_instrumentation_parameter.analog_filter: Hardware 4th-order anti-alias low-pass Butterworth filter (f_cutoff = 50.0 kHz, -80 dB/decade roll-off)
optoelectronic_instrumentation_parameter.sampling_margin_definition: Sampling at 1.0 MSa/s over the 50.0 kHz analog reconstructed band provides exactly 20x oversampling margin above the 50 kHz analog anti-alias filter cutoff, enabling true peak/trough waveform reconstruction.
optoelectronic_instrumentation_parameter.digital_filter: Digital moving median filter (window = 5 samples) for pulse transient de-glitching
optoelectronic_instrumentation_parameter.calibration_reference: ISO/IEC 17025 accredited fast-optical detector calibration certificate

gate_c7_acceptance_rule.rule: Gate C7 PASS requires BOTH Path 1 (Every point in [300, 400] lux and mean in [300, 400] lux) == PASS AND Path 2 (FI <= 0.05, f_mod >= 1000 Hz) == PASS.
